outcome: Number of breastfeeding sessions per day
Time spent at each breastfeeding session
Number of newborn stools and wet diapers produced daily
cohort: 2,966 nulliparous women with term, singleton deliveries at a large academic institution from 2017 to 2018
finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section, regardless of labor, were less likely to exclusively breastfeed and more likely to require formula supplementation compared to women who had vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: There was no difference in breastfeeding outcomes between scheduled cesarean section and cesarean section in labor.
